about.beta_body: This is an open-beta build (OB1.0.0). Features may still change or need a tweak on your side. Provided as-is — the author is not on the hook for lost data or unexpected downtime. Keep backups, use sensible passwords, and look after your own host and network. Try it, break it kindly, and tell us what to improve.
about.bug_body: Tell me what exploded. Screenshots are pure gold.
about.changelog.api: REST API v1:Isi njedebe enwetara nke ọma n'okpuru otu ikike ikike, maka njikọta na ihe ọ bụla ọzọ na-agba n'ala gị.
about.changelog.assets: Deba aha ihe bara uru na akara anụ ahụ:Full OEM/ akwụkwọ ikike / ndekọ ndụ, gbakwunyere QR & DataMatrix mbipụta akara - ụgwọ akwụghị ụgwọ maka Zebra ma ọ bụ ngwa nbipute ọ bụla, enweghị ịntanetị achọrọ.
about.changelog.design: Sistemụ ejikọtara ọnụ:Otu nleba anya na-anya n'ofe modulu ọ bụla - ederede AA-iche, otu ezinụlọ modal/bọtịnụ/ baajị, ezigbo ọkụ/ọchịchịrị, yana ndabere WebGL nke enwere ike gbanyụọ na igwe ochie.
about.changelog.inventory: Ngwaahịa nwere ezigbo Ledger:A na-edekọ mmegharị ọ bụla - oriri tiketi, oriri iji rụọ ọrụ, PO nnata - na-edekọ ma nwetaghachi azụ na ọrụ kpatara ya.
about.changelog.notif: Ọkwa & Ụzọ nyocha:Ngosipụta onye ọrụ maka nkwado, ngwaahịa dị ala na ọrụ agafeela, yana ndekọ nyocha na-enweghị mgbanwe n'azụ ha.
about.changelog.procurement: Ịzụta, Ọgwụgwụ ruo Ọgwụgwụ:Arịrịọ → nnabata ọnụ ahịa → mmezu nke onye na-echekwa → nnata ngwaahịa → mmezi mmefu ego, yana nzọụkwụ itoolu na-enyocha ọkwa na akụkọ ọkwa zuru oke.
about.changelog.rbac: Granular RBAC: 24 permissions across 6 editable roles, enforced server-side on every page and API endpoint — including separate tooling rights and a Storekeeper who can fulfil orders but never approve their cost.
about.changelog.reorder: Ndozigharị akpaaka chụpụrụ omume:Oriri nke na-agbada akụkụ na nke kacha nta na-ebuli ihe achọrọ na-akpaghị aka, site na otu iwu nkwado dị ka akwụkwọ ntuziaka.
about.changelog.security: Egwu siri ike site na Default:CSRF na mgbanwe steeti, nkwupụta akwadoro n'oge niile, ndozi oge na nchekwa ike ike, yana Evil Maid kpochie njide iweghara na nsochi nke onye ọrụ egosipụtara.
about.changelog.tickets: Oge ndụ tiketi zuru ezu:Deba aha → takeover → ime ihe → mmechi → akụkọ ihe mere eme nwere ike ịchọta, na-ejide oge na usoro ọ bụla ka MTTA na MTTR tụrụ, ọ bụghị atụmatụ.
about.changelog.ux: Ngwa-Aware UX: Ọnọdụ ejiri aka na-arụ ọrụ na-akpaghị aka - tebụl dara n'ime kaadị, kalenda na-aghọ atụmatụ, na ebumnuche mmetụ na-eto ruo nha-glove.
about.changelog.wo: Iwu ọrụ na nlekọta mgbochi:Usoro nhazi ugboro ugboro, ndetu ndenye nyocha ọzọ, nlele kalenda, na nchọpụta oge gafere nke na-apụta ihe dara ada.
about.chat_body: Ideas, questions, or plant-floor war stories — all welcome.
about.feat.analytics_body: Na-achịkọta telemetry ntinye aka raw iji gbakọọ oge a ga-emezi MTTR, soro oge nkwụsịtụ, nyochaa ọrụ ndị ọrụ nka, na iji anya nke uche hụ oriri akụkụ ka oge na-aga.
about.feat.assets_body: Na-edobe isi ihe nhazi CMMS sitere na ndị isi nrụtụ aka. A na-ejikọta igwe na obere mgbakọ na ngwa ngwa ha site na usoro iwu Bill of Materials BOM.
about.feat.docs_body: Nchekwa echedoro, raara onwe ya nye maka Safety SOPs, akwụkwọ ntuziaka nka, na blueprints. Na-amanye nke ọma ụdị nkwado MIME na ụzọ akwụkwọ dịpụrụ adịpụ iji kwe nkwa na akwụkwọ nchekwa dị mkpa na-enweta ya ozugbo site na ibe akụrụngwa.
about.feat.inventory: Ngwa ngwa ngwa ngwa & degharịa akpaaka
about.feat.inventory_body: Na-eso data ngwa ngwa zuru ezu, ọkwa ngwaahịa na mpaghara nnabata. Ngosipụta sistemu emegharị akpaaka efu nke na-ebute mgbe ngwaahịa dara n'okpuru ọnụ ụzọ akọwapụtara.
about.feat.lines: Ahịrị mmepụta & ụlọ ahịa ụlọ ahịa
about.feat.lines_body: Nlekọta ụlọ ọrụ n'uju-na-akara-na-ngwaọrụ nhazi ọkwa. Ahịrị mmepụta bụ ụmụ amaala klaasị mbụ nwere ọnụ ọgụgụ igwe, nleba anya ọkwa, yana ntinye aka na iwu ọrụ na akụrụngwa.
about.feat.modular_body: Nhazigharị zuru oke n'ime nchekwa nchekwa ngalaba ezi uche dị na ya (_mgmt, _maint, _eam, _prod, _logi, _rpt wdg) maka nkwado na mgbasawanye n'ọdịnihu. Ntụnyere aka niile, gụnyere, na nsoro ụzọ emelitere.
about.feat.pm_body: Igwe nhazi oge na-arụ ọrụ maka mmezi mgbochi PM. Na-esochi usoro oge agafee na akpaghị aka, na-agbanwe ike maka ezumike osisi, ma na-ahụta oke ọrụ na kalenda mmekọrịta.
about.feat.procurement_body: Na-ahazi yinye nnweta zuru ezu. Arịrịọ nzụta ime (PRs) na-abawanye na iwu ịzụrụ ihe (POs) ezigara ndị na-ere ahịa, na-edobe ndekọ nyocha IATF nke kwekọrọ n'okirikiri 9 dị iche iche PO statuses.
about.feat.rbac: Njikwa nnweta dabere na ọrụ RBAC
about.feat.rbac_body: Sistemụ ikike ọkwa ụlọ ọrụ na-anya nchekwa zuru oke. Site na modul granular ịnweta Evil Maid Nchekwa na-egbochi ịwepu nnọkọ oge na-akwadoghị n'oge iwere tiketi na nkwụsị.
about.feat.tickets: Ogologo ndụ tiketi zuru ezu (Mepee ka ọ kwụsị)
about.feat.tickets_body: Na-ejikwa mmejọ ụlọ ọrụ mmepụta ihe site na ndekọ mbụ ruo ọrụ ọkachamara na mkpebi ikpeazụ. Na-akwado ntinye aka ozugbo maka nrụzi ngwa ngwa.
about.indykb_blurb: Ezubere maka ndị ọrụ nka na-ekerịta ihe ọmụma n'ime ọkwa anyị, yana n'efu maka onye ọ bụla n'ụwa niile chọrọ ka ahịrị mmepụta ha na-aga n'ihu.

about.privacy_body: WCC is built for local / on-prem installs. It does not phone home, and it does not collect your plant data for anyone else. Tickets, assets, users, and files live in your database on your host. How safe that is depends on your own network, firewall, accounts, and backups — not on a cloud we control, because there isn’t one.
about.privacy_title: Runs on your machine — your data stays yours
about.release_intro: Open beta OB1.0.0 — the modules below are built, wired end to end, and exercised on plant-style data. Expect polish as the beta matures.
about.welcome: Nnọọ na Ụlọ Ọrụ Nchịkwa Ọmụmụ WCC. Nke a abụghị sọftụwia ụlọ ọrụ ọzọ gbajiri agbawa emebere n'ime ụlọ - ọ bụ arụmọrụ dị elu, ⟦CMMS na-enweghị usoro arụpụtara ozugbo n'ala ụlọ nrụpụta. Ndị ọkachamara na ndị injinia wuru, maka ndị ọrụ nka na injinia, WCC na-ewepụ ịdị arọ nke ụlọ ọrụ iji wepụta ihe dị mkpa n'ezie: ọsọ igbu oge. Emebere ya ka ọ rụọ ọrụ na nsọtụ, ọ na-akụda ọnụ ụzọ ámá ozi, na-etinye ngwaọrụ iji jikwaa usoro ndụ tiketi zuru oke, soro ngwa ahịa dị mkpa, na nyochaa KPI ozugbo n'aka gị.
